Definition: A local review handoff package of stable IDs, diagnostics, loss report, and boundaries assembled from a preview model and analysis run.
Record of omitted, approximated, delegated, and unsupported behaviors that are not bundled or generated for target-specific export.
Map of stable entity and result reference IDs used as cross-reference anchors in handoff and runner envelopes.
Boundary object asserting human review is required and the software makes no compliance, certification, sealing, approval, or authentication claim.
A schema-first local preview envelope describing a solve request and result handoff; final CLI/process/network policy remain TBD.
Local SQLite project store (SCA-003) where canonical truth is a canonical JSON JCS payload and SQL is not a public contract.
Source attribution of preview data as an invented fixture with license, contributor, certification, redistribution status, and review status.
Knowledge records combining stored records with computed mechanics context derived from result diagnostics and summaries.
Validation of an already-parsed library import document yielding an outcome (QUARANTINE/REJECTED/accepted) and blocking/advisory findings.
Policy that only an accepted private import is stored; a suspected-protected or otherwise-blocked import is refused and never written.
A local-only library import that is private-by-default and never transmitted, committed, or bundled into public artifacts (OPS-K-PRIV-1).
The kind of library document being managed: material, section, or component.
A named load case grouping primitive loads with id, label, kind, status, and provenance.
An individual user-entered load (force, moment, pressure, thermal, displacement) targeting a node, element, or support.
Closed set of primitive load categories.
A load combination with a basis (mechanics, result_state_subtraction, or range_envelope) and terms or operands.
Closed set of combination basis options mirroring load_case_algebra vocabulary.
Closed set of modes for a range_envelope combination.
Structured create/modify/delete operation intent with source, target, change, validation, audit_boundary, and professional_boundary; the only model-mutation route.
Boundary asserting structured-operations-only mutation, no direct model mutation, user acceptance required, and accepted model state not mutated.
Tauri unit catalog whose entries are labeled DEC-018 canonical or DEC-018 display, filtered by dimension.
Physical dimension assigned to a primitive load based on its category and direction.
